name: Money Minute
tagline: A one-minute daily check-in that logs spending and tracks a weekly limit
description: Once a day you say what you spent and it adds it to a running total, so the habit costs about a minute. Set a weekly ceiling if you like and it nudges you at eight in the evening when a day's figure is still unrecorded. Plain budgeting, nothing more: no trading, no market talk, no touching your money.
author: prorookiegamer
notes: Native Grok Bot share. Third-party bot; not from xAI.
